description: This file defines an interface 'IConnectionIssueListener' in the Orleans.EventSourcing namespace for monitoring connection issues in log-consistent grains.

classes.name: IConnectionIssueListener
classes.description: Interface for handling connection trouble events and resolution notifications in Orleans grains.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssue
methods.description: Method invoked when a connection issue occurs, allowing modification of retry delay.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssueResolved
methods.description: Method invoked when a previously reported connection issue is resolved.
